beats.text: Want more messages? Then not everyone should like your looks.
On a dating site, men rated how attractive women looked, from one to five.
Here are two women. Each dot is one rating.
Both get the same average: three.
But on the left, almost everyone says three. On the right, people say one, or five.
Women like her got far more messages. In one example, three times as many!
If some men aren't into her, others expect less competition. So don't try to please everyone. Because

sources: OkCupid (2011), 'The Mathematics Of Beauty' (OkTrends blog, platform data, not peer-reviewed) – men's 1–5 attractiveness ratings of women: among women with similar average scores, the more men disagreed (more 1s and 5s), the more messages they got; one woman rated '1' far more often than another (142 % more) still got about 3x the messages; suggested explanation: less perceived competition. The dots in the video are a schematic example.
